\"editable_assets\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"confluence_weights\",\n      \"path\": \"configs/signals/confluence-weights.yaml\",\n      \"description\": \"How much each tier contributes to confluence score\",\n      \"mutation_types\": [\"numeric_range\", \"numeric_relative\"],\n      \"safety\": \"high\",\n      \"human_review_required\": \"line_by_line\"  // optional\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\nSource: specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md § B.1.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom pathlib import entries.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass EditableAssetRegistry:\n    \"\"\"In-memory catalog of EditableAsset entries loaded from JSON config.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, assets: list[EditableAsset]):\n        self._by_id: dict[str, EditableAsset] = {}\n        for a in assets:\n            if a.asset_id in self._by_id:\n                raise RegistryFormatError(\n                    f\"duplicate asset_id {a.asset_id!r} in registry\"\n                )\n            self._by_id[a.asset_id] = a\n\n    @classmethod\n    def load_from_path(cls, path: Path | str) -> EditableAssetRegistry:\n        p = Path(path)\n        if not p.exists():\n            raise RegistryFormatError(f\"registry path does not exist: {p}\")\n        try:\n            payload = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n            raise RegistryFormatError(f\"registry JSON malformed at {p}: {exc}\") from exc\n        return cls.from_dict(payload)\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_dict(cls, payload: dict[str, object]) -> EditableAssetRegistry:\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or \"editable_assets\" not in payload:\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\n                \"registry payload must be {'editable_assets': [...]}\"\n            )\n        raw_list = payload[\"editable_assets\"]\n        if not isinstance(raw_list, list):\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\"'editable_assets' must be a list\")\n        assets: list[EditableAsset] = []\n        for idx, raw in enumerate(raw_list):\n            if not isinstance(raw, dict):\n                raise RegistryFormatError(\n                    f\"editable_assets[{idx}] must be an object, got {type(raw).__name__}\"\n                )\n            assets.append(cls._parse_one(idx, raw))\n        return cls(assets)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _parse_one(idx: int, raw: dict[str, object]) -> EditableAsset:\n        for required_field in (\"id\", \"path\", \"description\", \"mutation_types\", \"safety\"):\n            if required_field not in raw:\n                raise RegistryFormatError(\n                    f\"editable_assets[{idx}] missing required field {required_field!r}\"\n                )\n        mutation_types_raw = raw[\"mutation_types\"]\n        if not isinstance(mutation_types_raw, list) or not all(\n            isinstance(m, str) for m in mutation_types_raw\n        ):\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\n                f\"editable_assets[{idx}].mutation_types must be list[str]\"\n            )\n        safety_raw = raw[\"safety\"]\n        if not isinstance(safety_raw, str):\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\n                f\"editable_assets[{idx}].safety must be string\"\n            )\n        try:\n            safety = AssetSafety(safety_raw)\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\n                f\"editable_assets[{idx}].safety={safety_raw!r} not in \"\n                f\"{[s.value for s in AssetSafety]}\"\n            ) from exc\n        human_review = raw.get(\"human_review_required\")\n        if human_review is not None and not isinstance(human_review, str):\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\n                f\"editable_assets[{idx}].human_review_required must be string or null\"\n            )\n        try:\n            return EditableAsset(\n                asset_id=str(raw[\"id\"]),\n                path=str(raw[\"path\"]),\n                description=str(raw[\"description\"]),\n                mutation_types=tuple(mutation_types_raw),\n                safety=safety,\n                human_review_required=human_review,\n            )\n        except InvariantViolation as exc:\n            raise RegistryFormatError(\n                f\"editable_assets[{idx}] invariant violation: {exc}\"\n            ) from exc\n\n    def get(self, asset_id: str) -> EditableAsset | None:\n        return self._by_id.get(asset_id)\n\n    def all(self) -> list[EditableAsset]:\n        return list(self._by_id.values())\n\n    def iter_by_safety(self, safety: AssetSafety) -> Iterable[EditableAsset]:\n        for a in self._by_id.values():\n            if a.safety == safety:\n                yield a\n\n    def __len__(self) -> int:\n        return len(self._by_id)\n\n    def __contains__(self, asset_id: Year 2 EvalRunner reads\nHOLDOUT items via iter_holdout(); prompt-refinement experiments read TRAINING\nitems via iter_training(). The two surfaces are deliberately distinct — there\nis no `iter_all()` because BR-2 forbids mixing them.\n\nDisk layout (mirrors spec 005 § B.5 with concrete partition subdirs):\n\n    <root>/<kind_value>/<period_label>/<partition_value>/*.json\n\nExample:\n    eval-sets/thesis/2024-H1/holdout/hpg-2024-02-15.json\n    eval-sets/kol_recommendation/2024-H1/training/rec-001.json\n\nEach .json file describes one EvalSetItem:\n    {\n      \"item_id\": \"hpg-2024-02-15\",\n      \"as_of\": \"2024-02-15\",\n      \"ticker\": \"HPG\",                               // optional\n      \"known_outcome\": { \"return_3m\": 0.12, ... },\n      \"metadata\": { \"labeled_by\": \"owner\", ... }     // optional\n    }\n\nThe kind + partition + period come from the directory path; the JSON itself\ndoes not redundantly carry them (single source of truth = filesystem layout).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.models.eval_set_item import (\n    EvalSetItem,\n    InvariantViolation,\n)\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.value_objects.eval_kind import EvalKind\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.value_objects.eval_partition import EvalPartition\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.value_objects.eval_period import EvalPeriod\n\n__all__ = [\"EvalSetFormatError\", \"EvalSetStore\"]\n\n\nclass EvalSetFormatError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an eval-set file or directory has invalid shape.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Period label format: 'YYYY-H1' / 'YYYY-H2' / 'YYYY-Q1'..'YYYY-Q4' / 'YYYY-MM-DD_to_YYYY-MM-DD'.\n_HALF_RE = re.compile(r\"^(\\d{4})-H([12])$\")\n_QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r\"^(\\d{4})-Q([1-4])$\")\n_RANGE_RE = re.compile(r\"^(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})_to_(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})$\")\n\n\ndef _parse_period_label(label: str) -> EvalPeriod:\n    if m := _HALF_RE.match(label):\n        year = int(m.group(1))\n        half = int(m.group(2))\n        if half == 1:\n            return EvalPeriod(start=date(year, 1, 1), end=date(year, 6, 30))\n        return EvalPeriod(start=date(year, 7, 1), end=date(year, 12, 31))\n    if m := _QUARTER_RE.match(label):\n        year = int(m.group(1))\n        quarter = int(m.group(2))\n        starts = [(1, 1), (4, 1), (7, 1), (10, 1)]\n        ends = [(3, 31), (6, 30), (9, 30), (12, 31)]\n        return EvalPeriod(\n            start=date(year, *starts[quarter - 1]),\n            end=date(year, *ends[quarter - 1]),\n        )\n    if m := _RANGE_RE.match(label):\n        return EvalPeriod(\n            start=date.fromisoformat(m.group(1)),\n            end=date.fromisoformat(m.group(2)),\n        )\n    raise EvalSetFormatError(\n        f\"period label {label!r} not in 'YYYY-H1' | 'YYYY-Q1' | 'YYYY-MM-DD_to_YYYY-MM-DD'\"\n    )\n\n\nclass EvalSetStore:\n    \"\"\"Filesystem reader. Phase 3 read-only; Year 2 may add an `add_item` writer.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, root: Path | str):\n        self._root = Path(root)\n\n    @property\n    def root(self) -> Path:\n        return self._root\n\n    def iter_holdout(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None = None,\n    ) -> Iterable[EvalSetItem]:\n        return self._iter(kind, EvalPartition.HOLDOUT, period)\n\n    def iter_training(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None = None,\n    ) -> Iterable[EvalSetItem]:\n        return self._iter(kind, EvalPartition.TRAINING, period)\n\n    def count(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        partition: EvalPartition,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None = None,\n    ) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for _ in self._iter(kind, partition, period))\n\n    def _iter(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        partition: EvalPartition,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None,\n    ) -> Iterable[EvalSetItem]:\n        kind_dir = self._root / kind.value\n        if not kind_dir.is_dir():\n            return\n        for period_dir in sorted(kind_dir.iterdir()):\n            if not period_dir.is_dir():\n                continue\n            try:\n                period_obj = _parse_period_label(period_dir.name)\n            except EvalSetFormatError:\n                continue\n            if period is not None and (\n                period_obj.start != period.start or period_obj.end != period.end\n            ):\n                continue\n            partition_dir = period_dir / partition.value\n            if not partition_dir.is_dir():\n                continue\n            for item_path in sorted(partition_dir.glob(\"*.json\")):\n                yield self._load_item(item_path, kind, partition, period_obj)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _load_item(\n        path: Path,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        partition: EvalPartition,\n        period: EvalPeriod,\n    ) -> EvalSetItem:\n        try:\n            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item JSON malformed at {path}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path} must be a JSON object\")\n        for required in (\"item_id\", \"as_of\", \"known_outcome\"):\n            if required not in payload:\n                raise EvalSetFormatError(\n                    f\"item at {path} missing required field {required!r}\"\n                )\n        try:\n            as_of = date.fromisoformat(str(payload[\"as_of\"]))\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(\n                f\"item at {path}: as_of must be ISO date; got {payload['as_of']!r}\"\n            ) from exc\n        known_outcome_raw = payload[\"known_outcome\"]\n        if not isinstance(known_outcome_raw, dict):\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path}: known_outcome must be object\")\n        ticker_raw = payload.get(\"ticker\")\n        ticker = str(ticker_raw) if ticker_raw is not None else None\n        metadata_raw = payload.get(\"metadata\", {})\n        if not isinstance(metadata_raw, dict):\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path}: metadata must be object\")\n        try:\n            return EvalSetItem(\n                item_id=str(payload[\"item_id\"]),\n                kind=kind,\n                partition=partition,\n                period=period,\n                as_of=as_of,\n                ticker=ticker,\n                known_outcome=dict(known_outcome_raw),\n                metadata=dict(metadata_raw),\n            )\n        except InvariantViolation as exc:\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path} invariant violation: {exc}\") from exc\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":91185,"cache_read_input_tokens":17928,"output_tokens":7835,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":91185,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":7835,"cache_read_input_tokens":17928,"cache_creation_input_tokens":91185,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":91185},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"}},"requestId":"req_011Cary48cTH2U6W13hgp66x","type":"assistant","uuid":"fd4a6a7e-74b9-4535-8710-7a37253dac8d","timestamp":"2026-05-09T12:07:38.431Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"142a2b14-79c6-486b-8a85-0887f39d14e4","version":"2.1.126","gitBranch":"main"}

Year 2 EvalRunner reads\nHOLDOUT items via iter_holdout(); prompt-refinement experiments read TRAINING\nitems via iter_training(). The two surfaces are deliberately distinct — there\nis no `iter_all()` because BR-2 forbids mixing them.\n\nDisk layout (mirrors spec 005 § B.5 with concrete partition subdirs):\n\n    <root>/<kind_value>/<period_label>/<partition_value>/*.json\n\nExample:\n    eval-sets/thesis/2024-H1/holdout/hpg-2024-02-15.json\n    eval-sets/kol_recommendation/2024-H1/training/rec-001.json\n\nEach .json file describes one EvalSetItem:\n    {\n      \"item_id\": \"hpg-2024-02-15\",\n      \"as_of\": \"2024-02-15\",\n      \"ticker\": \"HPG\",                               // optional\n      \"known_outcome\": { \"return_3m\": 0.12, ... },\n      \"metadata\": { \"labeled_by\": \"owner\", ... }     // optional\n    }\n\nThe kind + partition + period come from the directory path; the JSON itself\ndoes not redundantly carry them (single source of truth = filesystem layout).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.models.eval_set_item import (\n    EvalSetItem,\n    InvariantViolation,\n)\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.value_objects.eval_kind import EvalKind\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.value_objects.eval_partition import EvalPartition\nfrom packages.domain.outer_loop.value_objects.eval_period import EvalPeriod\n\n__all__ = [\"EvalSetFormatError\", \"EvalSetStore\"]\n\n\nclass EvalSetFormatError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an eval-set file or directory has invalid shape.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Period label format: 'YYYY-H1' / 'YYYY-H2' / 'YYYY-Q1'..'YYYY-Q4' / 'YYYY-MM-DD_to_YYYY-MM-DD'.\n_HALF_RE = re.compile(r\"^(\\d{4})-H([12])$\")\n_QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r\"^(\\d{4})-Q([1-4])$\")\n_RANGE_RE = re.compile(r\"^(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})_to_(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})$\")\n\n\ndef _parse_period_label(label: str) -> EvalPeriod:\n    if m := _HALF_RE.match(label):\n        year = int(m.group(1))\n        half = int(m.group(2))\n        if half == 1:\n            return EvalPeriod(start=date(year, 1, 1), end=date(year, 6, 30))\n        return EvalPeriod(start=date(year, 7, 1), end=date(year, 12, 31))\n    if m := _QUARTER_RE.match(label):\n        year = int(m.group(1))\n        quarter = int(m.group(2))\n        starts = [(1, 1), (4, 1), (7, 1), (10, 1)]\n        ends = [(3, 31), (6, 30), (9, 30), (12, 31)]\n        return EvalPeriod(\n            start=date(year, *starts[quarter - 1]),\n            end=date(year, *ends[quarter - 1]),\n        )\n    if m := _RANGE_RE.match(label):\n        return EvalPeriod(\n            start=date.fromisoformat(m.group(1)),\n            end=date.fromisoformat(m.group(2)),\n        )\n    raise EvalSetFormatError(\n        f\"period label {label!r} not in 'YYYY-H1' | 'YYYY-Q1' | 'YYYY-MM-DD_to_YYYY-MM-DD'\"\n    )\n\n\nclass EvalSetStore:\n    \"\"\"Filesystem reader. Phase 3 read-only; Year 2 may add an `add_item` writer.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, root: Path | str):\n        self._root = Path(root)\n\n    @property\n    def root(self) -> Path:\n        return self._root\n\n    def iter_holdout(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None = None,\n    ) -> Iterable[EvalSetItem]:\n        return self._iter(kind, EvalPartition.HOLDOUT, period)\n\n    def iter_training(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None = None,\n    ) -> Iterable[EvalSetItem]:\n        return self._iter(kind, EvalPartition.TRAINING, period)\n\n    def count(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        partition: EvalPartition,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None = None,\n    ) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for _ in self._iter(kind, partition, period))\n\n    def _iter(\n        self,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        partition: EvalPartition,\n        period: EvalPeriod | None,\n    ) -> Iterable[EvalSetItem]:\n        kind_dir = self._root / kind.value\n        if not kind_dir.is_dir():\n            return\n        for period_dir in sorted(kind_dir.iterdir()):\n            if not period_dir.is_dir():\n                continue\n            try:\n                period_obj = _parse_period_label(period_dir.name)\n            except EvalSetFormatError:\n                continue\n            if period is not None and (\n                period_obj.start != period.start or period_obj.end != period.end\n            ):\n                continue\n            partition_dir = period_dir / partition.value\n            if not partition_dir.is_dir():\n                continue\n            for item_path in sorted(partition_dir.glob(\"*.json\")):\n                yield self._load_item(item_path, kind, partition, period_obj)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _load_item(\n        path: Path,\n        kind: EvalKind,\n        partition: EvalPartition,\n        period: EvalPeriod,\n    ) -> EvalSetItem:\n        try:\n            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item JSON malformed at {path}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path} must be a JSON object\")\n        for required in (\"item_id\", \"as_of\", \"known_outcome\"):\n            if required not in payload:\n                raise EvalSetFormatError(\n                    f\"item at {path} missing required field {required!r}\"\n                )\n        try:\n            as_of = date.fromisoformat(str(payload[\"as_of\"]))\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(\n                f\"item at {path}: as_of must be ISO date; got {payload['as_of']!r}\"\n            ) from exc\n        known_outcome_raw = payload[\"known_outcome\"]\n        if not isinstance(known_outcome_raw, dict):\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path}: known_outcome must be object\")\n        ticker_raw = payload.get(\"ticker\")\n        ticker = str(ticker_raw) if ticker_raw is not None else None\n        metadata_raw = payload.get(\"metadata\", {})\n        if not isinstance(metadata_raw, dict):\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path}: metadata must be object\")\n        try:\n            return EvalSetItem(\n                item_id=str(payload[\"item_id\"]),\n                kind=kind,\n                partition=partition,\n                period=period,\n                as_of=as_of,\n                ticker=ticker,\n                known_outcome=dict(known_outcome_raw),\n                metadata=dict(metadata_raw),\n            )\n        except InvariantViolation as exc:\n            raise EvalSetFormatError(f\"item at {path} invariant violation: {exc}\") from exc\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fd4a6a7e-74b9-4535-8710-7a37253dac8d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"142a2b14-79c6-486b-8a85-0887f39d14e4","version":"2.1.126","gitBranch":"main"}

metrics={\"thesis_hit_rate\": 0.55, \"alert_precision\": 0.8},\n        composite=0.62,\n        duration_ms=1500,\n        ran_at=datetime(2026, 5, 9, tzinfo=UTC),\n        extras={\"note\": \"confluence_weights\", \"mut-1\")\n    rec.record(snap)\n\n    fetched = rec.get_by_run_id(\"run-1\")\n    assert fetched is not None\n    assert fetched.run_id == \"run-1\"\n    assert _write_item(\n    root: Path,\n    kind: EvalKind,\n    period_label: str,\n    partition: EvalPartition,\n    item_id: str,\n    as_of: str,\n    outcome: dict,\n) -> None:\n    path = root /  _write_item(tmp_path, EvalKind.THESIS, \"2024-H1\", EvalPartition.HOLDOUT, \"h2\", \"2024-05-15\", {\"r3m\": 0.3})\n\n    store = EvalSetStore(tmp_path)\n    holdout = list(store.iter_holdout(EvalKind.THESIS))\n    training = list(store.iter_training(EvalKind.THESIS))\n\n    assert {i.item_id for i in holdout} == {\"h1\", \"h2\"}\n    assert {i.item_id for i in training} == {\"t1\"}\n    # BR-2: every holdout item carries HOLDOUT partition; no leak from training.\n    assert all(i.partition == EvalPartition.HOLDOUT for i in holdout)\n    assert EvalKind.PUMP, \"2023-H2\", EvalPartition.TRAINING, \"p3\", \"2023-11-01\", {\"label\": \"yes\"})\n\n    store = EvalSetStore(tmp_path)\n    assert store.count(EvalKind.PUMP, EvalPartition.HOLDOUT) == 2\n    assert store.count(EvalKind.PUMP, EvalPartition.TRAINING) == 1\n    assert store.count(EvalKind.THESIS, EvalPartition.HOLDOUT) == 0\n\n\ndef test_period_filter_only_returns_matching(tmp_path: Path) -> None:\n    _write_item(tmp_path, EvalKind.NARRATIVE, \"2024-H1\", EvalPartition.HOLDOUT, \"n1\", \"2024-02-15\", {\"phase\": \"EMERGING\"})\n    _write_item(tmp_path, EvalKind.NARRATIVE, \"2024-H2\", EvalPartition.HOLDOUT, \"n2\", \"2024-09-15\", {\"phase\": \"MAINSTREAM\"})\n\n    store = EvalSetStore(tmp_path)\n    h1 = list(\n        store.iter_holdout(\n            EvalKind.NARRATIVE,\n            period=EvalPeriod(start=date(2024, 1, 1), end=date(2024, 6, 30)),\n        )\n    )\n    assert [i.item_id for i in h1] == [\"n1\"]\n\n\ndef \"x.json\").write_text(\n        json.dumps({\"item_id\": \"x\", \"as_of\": \"2024-02-15\", \"known_outcome\": {\"r3m\": 0.1}}),\n        encoding=\"utf-8\",\n    )\n    store = EvalSetStore(tmp_path)\n    assert list(store.iter_holdout(EvalKind.THESIS)) == []\n\n\ndef test_malformed_item_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:\n    bad_dir = tmp_path / EvalKind.THESIS.value / \"2024-H1\" / EvalPartition.HOLDOUT.value\n    bad_dir.mkdir(parents=True)\n    (bad_dir / \"bad.json\").write_text(\"{not valid\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    store = EvalSetStore(tmp_path)\n    with pytest.raises(EvalSetFormatError, match=\"malformed\"):\n        list(store.iter_holdout(EvalKind.THESIS))\n\n\ndef test_iter_against_empty_root_returns_nothing(tmp_path: Path) -> None:\n    store = diacritics preserved (no stripping).\n12\t\n13\tHARD BINDING (S43a-CODE):\n14\t- mock_llm defaults True for development; set STOCKFORGE_MOCK_LLM=false + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\n15\t  for dogfood (pending Q&A 2026-05-01-002 gate).\n16\t\n17\tSource: specs/tier2-feature/006-phase-2-track-F-thesis-pipeline.md § B.7\n18\t\"\"\"\n19\t\n20\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n21\t\n22\timport asyncio\n23\timport os\n24\tfrom datetime import date\n25\tfrom decimal import Decimal\n26\tfrom pathlib import Path\n27\t\n28\timport streamlit as st  # type: ignore[import-not-found]\n29\t\n30\tfrom packages.application.analysis.ports.cost_tracker_port import CostBudgetExceeded\n31\tfrom packages.contracts.types import Ticker\n32\t\n33\t_DEFAULT_DB = Path(\"data/stockforge.sqlite\")\n34\t_DEFAULT_MAX_COST = Decimal(\"3.00\")\n35\t_DISCLAIMER_FOOTER = (\n36\t    \"Research aid — not financial advice (I-S35). \"\n37\t    \"Calibration grade: D (Phase 2 heuristic; no calibration data yet).\"\n38\t)\n39\t\n40\t\n41\tdef render() -> None:\n42\t    \"\"\"Render the Validate Thesis page.\"\"\"\n43\t    st.title(\"Validate Thesis\")\n44\t    st.caption(\"Run a 3-perspective analysis (Bear / Bull / Quant) on a VN30 ticker.\")\n45\t\n46\t    # --- Inputs ---\n47\t    ticker_raw = st.text_input(\"Ticker\", placeholder=\"e.g. HPG, VHM, FPT\")\n48\t    as_of_val: date = st.date_input(\"As of\", value=date.today())\n49\t\n50\t    mock_llm = os.environ.get(\"STOCKFORGE_MOCK_LLM\", \"true\").lower() != \"false\"\n51\t    db_path = Path(os.environ.get(\"STOCKFORGE_DB\", str(_DEFAULT_DB)))\n52\t    max_cost_usd = Decimal(os.environ.get(\"STOCKFORGE_MAX_COST_USD\", str(_DEFAULT_MAX_COST)))\n53\t\n54\t    if st.button(\"Validate\"):\n55\t        ticker_str = ticker_raw.strip().upper()\n56\t        if not ticker_str:\n57\t            st.error(\"Please enter a ticker symbol.\")\n58\t            return\n59\t\n60\t        _run_validation(\n61\t            ticker_str=ticker_str,\n62\t            as_of=as_of_val,\n63\t            db_path=db_path,\n64\t            mock_llm=mock_llm,\n65\t            max_cost_usd=max_cost_usd,\n66\t        )\n67\t\n68\t\n69\tdef _run_validation(\n70\t    *,\n71\t    ticker_str: str,\n72\t    as_of: date,\n73\t    db_path: Path,\n74\t    mock_llm: bool,\n75\t    max_cost_usd: Decimal,\n76\t) -> None:\n77\t    \"\"\"Execute the use case and render results (or errors).\"\"\"\n78\t    from apps._shared.use_case_builder import BuildError, build_use_case  # noqa: PLC0415\n79\t    from apps.dashboard.components.thesis_card import render_thesis_card  # noqa: PLC0415\n80\t\n81\t    with st.spinner(\n82\t        \"Running thesis validation... cost cap $3 / time cap 5 min. Please wait.\"\n83\t    ):\n84\t        try:\n85\t            use_case = build_use_case(\n86\t                db_path=db_path,\n87\t                mock_llm=mock_llm,\n88\t                max_cost_usd=max_cost_usd,\n89\t            )\n90\t        except BuildError as exc:\n91\t            st.error(f\"Configuration error: {exc}\")\n92\t            return\n93\t        except NotImplementedError as exc:\n94\t            st.error(f\"Live analysis gate not yet open: {exc}\")\n95\t            return\n96\t\n97\t        try:\n98\t            thesis = asyncio.run(\n99\t                use_case.execute(Ticker(ticker_str), as_of)\n100\t            )\n101\t        except CostBudgetExceeded as exc:\n102\t            st.error(\n103\t                f\"Cost budget exceeded: spent ${exc.spent:.4f} \"\n104\t                f\"(limit ${exc.limit:.4f}). {"parentUuid":"e39d677d-d6f4-4c4e-be3a-966125ee4f59","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01UyQXVzfkuHG3ccovVsCEGT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WtLjjZPCKaKjceNvhMtbZk","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\apps\\dashboard\\pages\\kol_daily_digest.py","content":"\"\"\"KOL Daily Digest page — UC-1 cross-cutting Streamlit view (BC-6).\n\nRead-only inspection of recent KOL recommendations.\nWires SqliteKolRepository.list_all + SqliteRecommendationRepository.find_recent.\n\nNO LLM calls / NO mutations / NO numbers computed by LLM (I-S1). Every recommendation\nshown carries source_url + extracted_at + extraction_confidence (≥0.7 BR-6 floor)\nverbatim from the persisted Recommendation aggregate.\n\nSource: specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md § B.3 UC-1.\nMaster-plan: agent-workspace/session-plans/pending/007-S44-phase-3-master-plan.md §S57 (Track M).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport os\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport streamlit as st  # type: ignore[import-not-found]\n\n_DEFAULT_DB = Path(\"data/stockforge.sqlite\")\n_DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7\n_DISCLAIMER_FOOTER = (\n    \"Research aid — not financial advice (I-S35). \"\n    \"KOL recommendations are extracted public statements; verify before acting.\"\n)\n\n\ndef render() -> None:\n    st.title(\"KOL Daily Digest\")\n    st.caption(\n        \"Recent KOL recommendations across the tracked roster. \"\n        \"Filter by lookback window or KOL.\"\n    )\n\n    db_path = Path(os.environ.get(\"STOCKFORGE_DB\", str(_DEFAULT_DB)))\n    if not db_path.exists():\n        st.info(\n            f\"No database at `{db_path}`. Ingest KOL channels first via \"\n            \"`python -m apps.cli.ingest_kol_channels`.\"\n        )\n        return\n\n    lookback_days = st.slider(\n        \"Lookback (days)\", min_value=1, max_value=30, value=_DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS\n    )\n\n    if st.button(\"Load digest\"):\n        _render_digest(db_path=db_path, lookback_days=lookback_days)\n\n\ndef _render_digest(*, db_path: Path, lookback_days: int) -> None:\n    from packages.infrastructure.influence.sqlite_kol_repository import (  # noqa: PLC0415\n        SqliteKolRepository,\n    )\n    from packages.infrastructure.influence.sqlite_recommendation_repository import (  # noqa: PLC0415\n        SqliteRecommendationRepository,\n    )\n\n    kol_repo = SqliteKolRepository(db_path)\n    rec_repo = SqliteRecommendationRepository(db_path)\n    since = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=lookback_days)\n\n    try:\n        kols = asyncio.run(kol_repo.list_all())\n        recommendations = asyncio.run(rec_repo.find_recent(since=since))\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        st.error(f\"Database read failed: {exc}\")\n        return\n\n    st.metric(\"Tracked KOLs\", len(kols))\n    st.metric(f\"Recommendations in last {lookback_days}d\", len(recommendations))\n\n    if not recommendations:\n        st.info(\"No recommendations in the selected window.\")\n        return\n\n    rows = [\n        {\n            \"kol_id\": str(r.kol_id),\n            \"ticker\": r.ticker,\n            \"intent\": r.intent.value,\n            \"timeframe\": r.timeframe.value,\n            \"confidence\": f\"{r.extraction_confidence:.2f}\",\n            \"published_at\": r.published_at.isoformat(),\n            \"source_url\": r.source_url,\n        }\n        for r in recommendations\n    ]\n    st.dataframe(rows, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)\n\n    st.caption(_DISCLAIMER_FOOTER)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1307,"cache_read_input_tokens":182055,"output_tokens":6700,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1307,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":6700,"cache_read_input_tokens":182055,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1307,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1307},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"}},"requestId":"req_011Carz3H8m5Lx4nZh8CPnUB","type":"assistant","uuid":"c056050b-2f60-4d81-b050-7749c8f41fb2","timestamp":"2026-05-09T12:19:43.742Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"142a2b14-79c6-486b-8a85-0887f39d14e4","version":"2.1.126","gitBranch":"main"}

Pump phase + narrative phase + recommendation\nintent all come verbatim from deterministic upstream classifiers.\n\nSource: specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md § B.3 UC-3\n        + specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md § B.3 UC-4 (confluence gate).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport os\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport streamlit as st  # type: ignore[import-not-found]\n\n_DEFAULT_DB = Path(\"data/stockforge.sqlite\")\n_DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 14\n_DISCLAIMER_FOOTER = (\n    \"Research aid — not financial advice (I-S35). \"\n    \"Pump alerts surface coordinated posting + suspicious phase transitions; \"\n    \"human review required before any action.\"\n)\n\n\ndef render() -> None:\n    st.title(\"Confluence Alerts\")\n    st.caption(\n        \"Pump detections + counter-narratives + KOL recommendation cluster. \"\n        \"Combines BC-7 crowd surveillance with BC-6 KOL flow.\"\n    )\n\n    db_path = Path(os.environ.get(\"STOCKFORGE_DB\", str(_DEFAULT_DB)))\n    if not db_path.exists():\n        st.info(\n            f\"No database at `{db_path}`. Run BC-7 + BC-6 ingestion + classification first.\"\n        )\n        return\n\n    lookback_days = st.slider(\n        \"Lookback (days)\", min_value=1, max_value=60, value=_DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS\n    )\n    ticker_filter = st.text_input(\"Filter by ticker (optional)\").strip().upper()\n\n    if st.button(\"Load alerts\"):\n        _render_alerts(\n            db_path=db_path,\n            lookback_days=lookback_days,\n            ticker_filter=ticker_filter or None,\n        )\n\n\ndef _render_alerts(\n    *,\n    db_path: Path,\n    lookback_days: int,\n    ticker_filter: str | None,\n) -> None:\n    from packages.infrastructure.crowd.sqlite_pump_detection_repository import (  # noqa: PLC0415\n        SqlitePumpDetectionRepository,\n    )\n    from packages.infrastructure.influence.sqlite_recommendation_repository import (  # noqa: PLC0415\n        SqliteRecommendationRepository,\n    )\n\n    pump_repo = SqlitePumpDetectionRepository(db_path)\n    rec_repo = SqliteRecommendationRepository(db_path)\n    since = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=lookback_days)\n\n    try:\n        pending = pump_repo.get_pending_review()\n        recent_recs = asyncio.run(rec_repo.find_recent(since=since))\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        st.error(f\"Database read failed: {exc}\")\n        return\n\n    if ticker_filter:\n        pending = [d for d in pending if d.ticker == ticker_filter]\n        recent_recs = [r for r in recent_recs if r.ticker == ticker_filter]\n\n    col_a, col_b = st.columns(2)\n    col_a.metric(\"Pending pump reviews\", len(pending))\n    col_b.metric(f\"KOL recs in last {lookback_days}d\", len(recent_recs))\n\n    st.subheader(\"Pump Detections (pending review)\")\n    if not pending:\n        st.info(\"No pending pump detections.\")\n    else:\n        pump_rows = [\n            {\n                \"detection_id\": str(d.detection_id)[:12] + \"...\",\n                \"ticker\": d.ticker,\n                \"phase\": d.pump_phase.value,\n                \"detected_at\": d.detected_at.isoformat(),\n                \"evidence_count\": len(d.evidence),\n            }\n            for d in pending\n        ]\n        st.dataframe(pump_rows, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)\n\n    st.subheader(\"KOL Recommendation Cluster\")\n    if not recent_recs:\n        st.info(\"No KOL recommendations in the selected window.\")\n    else:\n        from collections import Counter  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _pt(text: str = \"point\", cat: str | None = None) -> GroundedPoint:\n    return GroundedPoint(\n        text=text,\n        source_url=\"https://mock.example.com/filing\",\n        source_excerpt=\"Verbatim excerpt for dashboard smoke test.\",\n        as_of=_TODAY,\n        conviction=Conviction.MODERATE,\n        category=cat,\n    )\n\n\ndef _make_submitted_thesis(ticker: str = \"HPG\") -> Thesis:\n    bear = PerspectiveAnalysis(\n        role=PerspectiveRole.BEAR,\n        key_points=(\n            _pt(\"Fundamental risk\", BearCategory.FUNDAMENTAL),\n            _pt(\"Valuation risk\", BearCategory.VALUATION),\n            _pt(\"Macro risk\", BearCategory.MACRO),\n        ),\n        overall_conviction=Conviction.MODERATE,\n        cost_usd=Decimal(\"0.10\"),\n        model_id=\"mock-llm\",\n        prompt_hash=\"smoketest0123456\",\n    )\n    bull = PerspectiveAnalysis(\n        role=PerspectiveRole.BULL,\n        key_points=(_pt(\"Growth\"), _pt(\"Moat\")),\n        overall_conviction=Conviction.MODERATE,\n        cost_usd=Decimal(\"0.10\"),\n        model_id=\"mock-llm\",\n        prompt_hash=\"smoketest0123456\",\n    )\n    quant = PerspectiveAnalysis(\n        role=PerspectiveRole.QUANT,\n        key_points=(_pt(\"P/B below avg\"),),\n        overall_conviction=Conviction.MODERATE,\n        cost_usd=Decimal(\"0.10\"),\n        model_id=\"mock-llm\",\n        prompt_hash=\"smoketest0123456\",\n    )\n    matrix = TradeOffMatrix(\n        scores={d: DimensionVerdict.NEUTRAL for d in (\"VALUE\", \"QUALITY\", \"GROWTH\", \"RISK\")},\n        evidence={d: () for d in (\"VALUE\", \"QUALITY\", \"GROWTH\", \"RISK\")},\n    )\n    synthesis = Synthesis(\n        trade_off_matrix=matrix,\n        confluence_assessment=Confluence.MIXED,\n        explicit_disagreements=(),\n        catalysts=(),\n        risks=(),\n        reasoning_trace=\"smoke test synthesis trace\",\n    )\n    from packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.confidence_level import (\n        ConfidenceLevel,  # noqa: PLC0415\n    )\n    from packages.domain.analysis.value_objects.recommendation import (\n        Recommendation,  # noqa: PLC0415\n    )\n\n    return Thesis(\n        thesis_id=\"smoketestid\" + \"0\" * 54,\n        ticker=Ticker(ticker),\n        as_of=_TODAY,\n        created_at=datetime.now(UTC),\n        status=ThesisStatus.SUBMITTED,\n        perspectives=(bear, bull, quant),\n        synthesis=synthesis,\n        final_recommendation=Recommendation.INVESTIGATE,\n        confidence_level=ConfidenceLevel.MEDIUM,\n        cost_usd=Decimal(\"0.30\"),\n    )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Tests\n# pytest.skip(\"streamlit.testing.v1 not available in this environment\")\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"STOCKFORGE_MOCK_LLM\", \"true\")\n\n    at = AppTest.from_file(\"apps/dashboard/main.py\", assert date_input_val == _dt.date.today(), (\n        f\"date_input default should be today ({_dt.date.today()}); got {date_input_val}\"\n    )\n\n\ndef
